_comment: Motor mount bracket — wall-mounted plate at x_min, motor-mount face at x_max.
_architecture: Phase 5 two-region domain. Attachment slab bc=none. Fixity at 4 wall bolt patches via load_case.fixed corners selector. Load distributed across full x_max face, gravity direction.
_load_case_note: Single load case: gravity only (-Z) on full x_max face. NEMA bolt pattern selector and multi-load case come next session.
_bc_note: bc=none keeps slab forced-solid but does NOT fix entire x_min face. Only 4 corner disk patches at wall bolt positions are fixed. Correct physical setup.

load_case._comment: Fixed: 4 corner disk patches at wall bolt positions on x_min. Inside forced-solid slab so always in solid material. disk_radius_m=0.006 > bolt void radius 0.004. Load: full x_max, gravity -Z, 5000N.

attachment_regions._comment: 6mm wall plate at x_min. Forced solid, bc=none. Fixity owned by load_case.fixed corner disks. Bolt voids punched post-marking.

bolt_seats._comment: NEMA-17 motor bolts — exit collar at x_max only. void_radius_m=0.004 > filter_radius=0.003.
